title: SecReason: Vulnerability Detection and In-Stream Self-Repair for LLM Code Generation
title_zh: SecReason：面向 LLM 代码生成的漏洞检测与流式自修复

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) may introduce security vulnerabilities into generated code, which can persist into deployed systems when verification focuses on functional correctness. Security prompts and retrieved security knowledge act before any code exists, constrained decoding limits token choices but cannot guide repair, and post-hoc repair must regenerate the full response. None of them inspects the code during generation. Reasoning LLMs draft code early in their chain of thought, well before delivery. We present SecReason , an in-stream defense that monitors this pre-delivery window and inspects the code during generation. Dual-track incremental scanning applies security rules, checking each completed statement as it is emitted and tracing dataflows across the accumulated code. When a security rule fires, SecReason interrupts generation, inserts an in-stream warning, and resumes decoding, so the model repairs the draft within the same reasoning trace. On tasks where unassisted generation introduces vulnerabilities, SecReason raises the share of runs delivering secure and functionally correct code from below 15% to 72.8%–98.1% on CWEval and SecCodeBench under a corpus-calibrated ruleset. SecReason consumes fewer tokens than post-hoc repair and, when security rules misfire on secure code, shows smaller functional regressions.

paragraphs.en: Developers increasingly delegate implementation tasks to code assistants and coding agents built on large language models (LLMs), but the generated code can introduce security vulnerabilities such as injection and weak cryptography ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Ramírez et al., 2025 ) . Because developers primarily verify functionality and rarely screen for security, they tend to trust code that executes correctly ( Perry et al., 2023 ; Khalid et al., 2027 ) , so functionally correct but vulnerable code persists in software repositories. In automated environments, agents write and execute code without intermediate human inspection ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , so such code reaches execution undetected.
paragraphs.zh: 开发者越来越多地将实现任务委托给基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的代码助手和编码智能体，但生成的代码可能会引入注入和弱加密等安全漏洞（Pearce 等人，2022；Fu 等人，2025；Ramírez 等人，2025）。 由于开发者主要验证功能而很少检查安全性，他们倾向于信任能够正确运行的代码（Perry 等人，2023；Khalid 等人，2027），因此功能正确但存在漏洞的代码会持续存在于软件仓库中。 在自动化环境中，智能体无需人类中间检查即可编写和执行代码（Yang 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2024），因此这类代码会在未被检测到的情况下进入执行阶段。

paragraphs.en: Existing defenses act before, during, or after generation, but none inspects the code during generation. Security fine-tuning ( He et al., 2024 ) , security prompts ( Sajadi et al., 2025 ) , and retrieved security knowledge ( Lin et al., 2025 ) act before any code exists, so they cannot verify whether the delivered code is secure or name the flaw in a specific draft. Constrained decoding methods act during generation, enforcing grammar ( Ugare et al., 2025 ) , conditioning on execution feedback ( Lavon et al., 2025 ) , or blocking completions matching known weakness patterns ( Storhaug et al., 2023 ) , but none can guide the model to repair its code. Post-generation defenses, such as static scanners ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) and automated program repair ( Pearce et al., 2023 ; Alrashedy et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , inspect code precisely but only after generation completes. Static analyzers raise many false alarms ( Johnson et al., 2013 ; Sadowski et al., 2018 ) , so a checker that inspects every generation often flags code that is in fact secure. Repairing a flagged vulnerability then requires regenerating the full response, which increases token consumption and risks breaking working code, and this cost recurs even when the alarm was false.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的防御机制在生成前、生成中或生成后发挥作用，但没有一种能在生成过程中检查代码。 安全微调（He 等人，2024）、安全提示（Sajadi 等人，2025）以及检索到的安全知识（Lin 等人，2025）在代码生成之前就已介入，因此它们无法验证所生成的代码是否安全，也无法指出特定草案中的缺陷。 受限解码方法在生成过程中发挥作用，包括强制遵循语法规则（Ugare 等人，2025）、基于执行反馈进行条件约束（Lavon 等人，2025），或阻止与已知弱点模式匹配的补全结果（Storhaug 等人，2023），但没有一种方法能引导模型修复其代码。 生成后的防御机制，例如静态扫描器（Sun 等人，2024；Li 等人，2025）和自动化程序修复工具（Pearce 等人，2023；Alrashedy 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2026），虽然能精确检查代码，但只能在生成完成后进行。 静态分析器会产生大量误报（Johnson 等人，2013；Sadowski 等人，2018），因此对每次生成结果进行检查的验证工具往往会将实际上安全的代码标记为不安全。 要修复被标记的漏洞，就需要重新生成整个响应内容，这会增加令牌消耗量，并可能破坏原本正常运行的代码；即使误报成立，这种成本仍需重复承担。

We measure how often the models deliver insecure code, how much of the delivered code the reasoning drafts already contain, and how early these drafts finish. The study covers six open-weight models, which expose complete reasoning streams, and 173 tasks from two security benchmarks, CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) and SecCodeBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Section 2.1 narrates the example behind the figure, and Section 2.2 details the protocol and reports the per-model results.
paragraphs.zh: 推理大语言模型（OpenAI，2024；Google DeepMind，2025；Guo 等，2025）使得代码在生成过程中可以被检查。 在给出最终答案之前，这些模型会输出一个扩展的思考链（Wei 等，2022），并且实现通常是在这个思考痕迹中草拟的，而不是在其之后（图1，左侧）。 我们衡量模型产生不安全代码的频率、已交付代码中推理草拟部分所占的比例，以及这些草拟部分完成的时间早晚。 该研究涵盖了六个开放权重的模型，这些模型会暴露完整的推理流程，以及来自两个安全基准测试的173项任务：CWEval（Peng 等，2025）和 SecCodeBench（Chen 等，2026）。 第2.1节阐述了该图背后的示例，而第2.2节则详细说明了实验协议并报告了各模型的具体结果。

paragraphs.en: Across the six models, 13.2% to 35.6% of functionally valid generations on CWEval and 42.6% to 61.3% on SecCodeBench fail security tests. Security terms do appear in these traces, but among runs whose reasoning mentions them, 5.4% to 61.1% still deliver insecure code.
paragraphs.zh: 在六个模型中，CWEval 上功能有效的生成结果中有 13.2% 到 35.6% 未能通过安全测试，而 SecCodeBench 上的这一比例为 42.6% 到 61.3%。 这些追踪记录中确实出现了安全相关术语，但在推理过程中提及这些术语的运行中，仍有 5.4% 到 61.1% 生成了不安全的代码。

sents.en: Across the six models, 13.2% to 35.6% of functionally valid generations on CWEval and 42.6% to 61.3% on SecCodeBench fail security tests.
sents.zh: 在六个模型中，CWEval 上功能有效的生成结果中有 13.2% 到 35.6% 未能通过安全测试，而 SecCodeBench 上的这一比例为 42.6% 到 61.3%。

sents.en: Security terms do appear in these traces, but among runs whose reasoning mentions them, 5.4% to 61.1% still deliver insecure code.

paragraphs.en: In these same traces, 52.4% to 99.8% of delivered lines appear verbatim in a fenced code block of the reasoning, and five of the six models exceed 73% on both benchmarks. The best-matching draft closes at 45.2% to 89.1% of the trace, leaving 203 to 6,028 reasoning tokens on average before delivery. The interval between drafting and delivery is therefore a pre-delivery window in which the code that will be delivered already exists.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些相同的痕迹中，52.4%到99.8%的已交付行在推理部分的代码块中以原样出现，并且六个模型中有五个在两项基准测试中都超过了73%。 最佳匹配草稿在痕迹中的占比为45.2%到89.1%，在交付前平均剩余203到6,028个推理标记。 因此，起草与交付之间的时间间隔是一个预交付窗口，在此窗口中，即将被交付的代码已经存在。

paragraphs.en: We build on this observation and introduce in-stream detection , which runs the checker during generation, not after it. The checker scans the draft as it is generated, statement by statement. When it reports a potential vulnerability, a short warning is inserted into the ongoing reasoning. The model then decides how to respond, fixing the draft before the final code if the alarm is real and verifying the flagged code if it is false, so no extra turn is needed. Handling an alarm costs a few reasoning tokens, so false alarms become cheap, not costly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于这一观察，引入了流式检测机制，该机制在生成过程中运行检查器，而非生成之后。 检查器在草案生成时逐条进行扫描。 当检查器报告潜在漏洞时，会在当前的推理过程中插入一条简短的警告。 随后，模型会决定如何响应：如果警报属实，则在最终代码生成前修正草案；如果警报为假，则对标记出的代码进行验证，因此无需额外步骤。 处理一次警报仅消耗少量推理令牌，因此误报的成本很低，而非高昂。

paragraphs.en: Applying static analysis inside the reasoning stream is not straightforward. Static analyzers expect complete, syntactically valid files, whereas reasoning streams interleave partial code with natural-language text. An in-stream defense must recognize statements as they complete and translate structured analyzer findings into feedback that the model can act on within the ongoing trace.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理流中应用静态分析并非易事。 静态分析器需要完整且语法正确的文件，而推理流则将部分代码与自然语言文本交错呈现。 流内防御必须能在语句完成时识别它们，并将结构化分析器的发现转化为模型能够在此持续追踪过程中采取行动的反馈。

sents.en: Applying static analysis inside the reasoning stream is not straightforward.
sents.zh: 在推理流中应用静态分析并非易事。

sents.en: Static analyzers expect complete, syntactically valid files, whereas reasoning streams interleave partial code with natural-language text.
sents.zh: 静态分析器需要完整且语法正确的文件，而推理流则将部分代码与自然语言文本交错呈现。

sents.en: An in-stream defense must recognize statements as they complete and translate structured analyzer findings into feedback that the model can act on within the ongoing trace.
sents.zh: 流内防御必须能在语句完成时识别它们，并将结构化分析器的发现转化为模型能够在此持续追踪过程中采取行动的反馈。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges (Section 2.3 ), we present SecReason , an in-stream defense system that intercepts vulnerable code drafts during reasoning and guides the model to repair them before delivery (Figure 1 , right). Operating at the inference serving layer without modifying model weights, SecReason parses the streaming reasoning trace incrementally to recognize completed statements. To balance latency against detection depth, it scans a security ruleset on two tracks. A statement-local track checks each completed statement as it is emitted, and a context-dependent track catches dataflows spanning the accumulated code.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战（第 2.3 节），我们提出了 SecReason——一种流式防御系统，它能在推理过程中拦截存在漏洞的代码草案，并在代码交付前引导模型进行修复（图 1，右侧）。 SecReason 在推理服务层运行且无需修改模型权重，通过增量解析流式推理轨迹来识别已完成的语句。 为平衡延迟与检测深度，该系统沿两条路径扫描安全规则集。 一条语句级路径在每条完成语句生成时立即进行检查，另一条上下文依赖路径则能捕捉贯穿已积累代码的数据流。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SecReason on the same 173 tasks in five programming languages. Streaming detection replays the generations of all six models, and in-stream self-repair runs on two locally deployed models over the tasks where unassisted generation introduces vulnerabilities. On these tasks, in-stream self-repair matches or exceeds post-hoc repair in every benchmark and model combination, raising the share of runs delivering secure and functionally correct code from below 15 % 15\% to 72.8 % 72.8\% – 98.1 % 98.1\% under a corpus-calibrated ruleset while consuming fewer tokens. When security rules misfire on secure code, SecReason also shows smaller functional regressions than post-hoc repair.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五种编程语言中，使用相同的 173 个任务对 SecReason 进行了评估。 流式检测会重播所有六个模型的生成过程，而流式自我修复则针对未受辅助的生成引入漏洞的任务，在本地部署的两个模型上运行。 在这些任务中，流式自我修复在所有基准和模型组合中都与事后修复相当或更优，使得能够生成安全且功能正确的代码的运行比例从低于 15% 15\% 提升至 72.8% 72.8\% – 98.1% 98.1\%（在语料校准的规则集下），同时消耗的 token 更少。 当安全规则对安全代码误判时，SecReason 的功能退化程度也小于事后修复。

paragraphs.en: An empirical study of six reasoning models on 173 tasks, showing that implementations are drafted early in the reasoning stream, while security-term mentions do not reliably prevent insecure delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 一项针对六个推理模型在173项任务上的实证研究表明，实现方案在推理流程的早期阶段即已拟定，而安全术语的出现并未能可靠地防止不安全交付。

paragraphs.en: SecReason , an in-stream defense at the inference serving layer that recognizes completed statements in the streaming reasoning trace and inserts warnings prompting the model to repair vulnerable drafts before delivery.
paragraphs.zh: SecReason，一种位于推理服务层的流式防御机制，能够识别流式推理轨迹中已完成的陈述，并插入警告，提示模型在交付前修复存在漏洞的初稿。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation on CWEval and SecCodeBench showing that in-stream self-repair matches or exceeds post-hoc repair while consuming fewer tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CWEval 和 SecCodeBench 上的评估表明，流式自修复在消耗更少 token 的同时，效果与事后修复相当甚至更优。

paragraphs.en: Reasoning models (e.g., the GPT , Qwen , and GLM families) reason ( Wei et al., 2022 ) by default when generating code, and some (such as GLM - 5.3 ) offer no option to disable it. Figure 1 in the introduction shows this task side by side, unassisted on the left and under SecReason on the right. The left trace is a run of Qwen3 .6 - 35 B - A3B . Prompted to build a URL from a trusted domain and a user-supplied subdomain prefix, the model streams its reasoning before delivering the final code. During this trace, the model interleaves natural-language reasoning with drafted code, evaluating edge cases for “empty or invalid” input before writing a preliminary implementation inside a markdown code fence. After the fenced block, the model reviews the draft and concludes that the validation is sufficient (e.g., “This covers empty…”). Finally, the model delivers this drafted code as its final response, unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 推理模型（例如 GPT、Qwen 和 GLM 系列）在生成代码时默认会进行推理（Wei et al., 2022），其中一些模型（如 GLM-5.3）甚至不提供禁用该功能的选项。 引言部分的图 1 将这项任务并列展示：左侧为无人协助的情况，右侧为使用 SecReason 辅助的情况。 左侧的追踪记录来自 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的一次运行。 在提示模型基于一个可信域和用户提供的子域名前缀构建 URL 时，模型会在输出最终代码之前先逐步呈现其推理过程。 在此追踪过程中，模型交替使用自然语言推理和草拟的代码，在编写初步实现之前，会先评估“空输入或无效输入”等边界情况，并将初步实现写入一个 Markdown 代码围栏中。 在代码围栏块之后，模型会审查该草案，并得出结论：验证是充分的（例如，“这涵盖了空输入的情况……”）。 最后，模型将这份草拟的代码作为最终响应直接输出，内容未作任何修改。

paragraphs.en: However, the delivered code is vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF, CWE-918 in the Common Weakness Enumeration). Earlier in the same trace, before drafting the implementation, the model had explicitly identified # and ? as characters that render the prefix invalid, but the drafted validation checks only for slashes and empty strings. Because # and ? begin the fragment or query component in URL syntax, they terminate the host. A payload such as evil . com # bypasses the check and directs requests to the untrusted evil . com domain. In this trace, unassisted self-review provides no diagnostic feedback on the drafted validation. Re-reading the draft does not bring back the # and ? cases that the model’s earlier reasoning had identified. The right trace of Figure 1 previews the corresponding trajectory under SecReason , where an in-stream warning inserted at the flawed check is repaired within the same reasoning (Section 3 ).

paragraphs.en: While the motivating example illustrates that unassisted self-review can fail on an individual task, a single trace cannot answer how often models deliver insecure code, how often their reasoning mentions security, and how early code drafts form. paragraphs.en: We evaluate these models on two code generation benchmarks, CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) and SecCodeBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . We include every task written in Python, JavaScript, Java, C, or C++. This yields 173 tasks in total, 97 from CWEval and 76 from SecCodeBench . To evaluate the delivered code, we execute each benchmark’s functional and security test suites, labeling a generation as insecure if it passes functional verification but fails at least one security test. We scan reasoning traces for the security term stems secur- and vulnerab- . Verbatim line recall denotes the fraction of delivered lines (non-empty, non-comment) that appear verbatim in some fenced block. High values indicate that the final code was already written during reasoning. Draft completion denotes the trace position at which the best-matching fenced block, the block sharing the most delivered lines, closes. Post-draft tokens denote the number of reasoning tokens generated after that position.

paragraphs.en: Models deliver insecure code. On CWEval , between 13.2% and 35.6% of functionally valid generations fail security tests. On SecCodeBench , between 42.6% and 61.3% fail.
paragraphs.zh: 模型会生成不安全的代码。 在 CWEval 中，功能有效的生成结果中有 13.2% 到 35.6% 未能通过安全测试。 在 SecCodeBench 中，有 42.6% 到 61.3% 的生成结果未能通过测试。

paragraphs.en: Security-term mentions do not ensure secure code. Among insecure generations, 16.7% to 66.7% of reasoning traces on CWEval and 23.1% to 54.5% on SecCodeBench mention security terms. Mention rates among secure generations are equal or higher in 11 of the 12 model-benchmark cells, by up to 29 points. Among generations whose traces do mention security terms, 5.4% to 61.1% still fail security tests. These mention statistics rely on lexicon matching, and we treat them purely as correlational observations.
paragraphs.zh: 安全术语的出现并不保证代码是安全的。 在不安全的生成结果中，CWEval 上 16.7% 到 66.7% 的推理轨迹和 SecCodeBench 上 23.1% 到 54.5% 的推理轨迹提到了安全术语。 在 12 个模型-基准单元格中，有 11 个单元格显示安全生成结果中的提及率相等或更高，差异最高可达 29 个百分点。 在那些推理轨迹确实提到了安全术语的生成结果中，仍有 5.4% 到 61.1% 的结果未能通过安全测试。 这些提及统计数据依赖于词汇表匹配，我们将其纯粹视为相关性观察。

paragraphs.en: The delivered code is drafted during reasoning, well before delivery. On both benchmarks, 52.4% to 99.8% of delivered lines appear verbatim inside fenced blocks of the reasoning trace. Five of the six models exceed 73% on both, and the exception, Kimi - K3 , still reaches 52.4% and 68.8%. Draft completion ranges from 45.2% to 89.1% of the trace, leaving 203 to 6,028 post-draft tokens on average before delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 交付的代码在推理过程中草拟完成，远早于实际交付。 在这两项基准测试中，52.4% 至 99.8% 的交付代码行都原封不动地出现在推理轨迹的围栏块内。 六个模型中有五个在这两项测试中的表现均超过 73%，而唯一的例外 Kimi - K3 也分别达到了 52.4% 和 68.8%。 草拟完成度占推理轨迹的比例从 45.2% 到 89.1% 不等，平均而言，在交付前还剩余 203 至 6,028 个草拟后的词元。

paragraphs.en: In automated environments, coding agents write and execute code without intermediate human inspection ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , so any vulnerability in the generated code reaches execution without review. Because vulnerable code often passes the functional tests used in such environments, it crosses the delivery boundary undetected. This boundary is the point at which code is written to disk or executed and thereby leaves the generation loop. Crossing it closes the pre-delivery window. In standard generation pipelines, post-generation defenses, such as scanners that inspect completed code ( Semgrep, Inc., 2026 ; PyCQA, 2026 ) , operate only after the boundary has been crossed.
paragraphs.zh: 在自动化环境中，编码智能体无需人类中间检查即可编写和执行代码（Yang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2024），因此生成的代码中任何漏洞都会未经审查直接进入执行阶段。 由于存在漏洞的代码通常能通过此类环境中使用的功能测试，它会在未被检测到的情况下跨越交付边界。 这一边界是指代码被写入磁盘或执行，从而脱离生成循环的节点。 跨越该边界即意味着预交付窗口关闭。 在标准的生成流程中，生成后的防御机制（例如检查已完成代码的扫描工具，Semgrep, Inc., 2026；PyCQA, 2026）仅在代码跨越该边界之后才会启动。

paragraphs.en: Security-term mentions do not reliably prevent insecure delivery. Unassisted self-review receives no external feedback, and in the motivating example it left the omission undetected. These findings point to an opportunity to intercept the vulnerability during generation, through in-stream analysis . Because the delivered code is drafted well before delivery, an analyzer can inspect the draft as the trace unfolds and insert warnings into the stream. A warning supplies the feedback that self-review lacks. It names the flaw in the draft while generation is still underway, so the model can repair it within the ongoing reasoning trace, before the code is delivered. The warning is inserted into the ongoing stream, and the task prompt itself remains unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 安全术语的提及并不能可靠地防止不安全交付。 无人协助的自我审查无法获得外部反馈，在激励性示例中，这种方式甚至未能发现遗漏之处。 这些发现表明，通过流内分析，有机会在生成过程中拦截该漏洞。 由于交付的代码在交付前很久就已起草，分析器可以在追踪过程展开时检查草稿，并在数据流中插入警告。 警告提供了自我审查所缺乏的反馈。 它在生成仍在进行时就指出了草稿中的缺陷，这样模型就能在持续的推理追踪过程中修复它，而无需等到代码交付。 警告被插入到正在进行的流程中，而任务提示本身则保持不变。

paragraphs.en: An analyzer built on static analysis fits this role, but applying it to streaming reasoning traces presents three practical challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 基于静态分析的分析器适合这一角色，但将其应用于流式推理轨迹时会面临三个实际挑战。

paragraphs.en: C1. Triggering Scans on Incomplete Token Streams. Standard static analyzers (such as Semgrep ( Semgrep, Inc., 2026 ) and Bandit ( PyCQA, 2026 ) ) parse complete, syntactically valid code, so triggering analysis at arbitrary token boundaries yields fragments that AST parsers reject. At the other extreme, waiting for a markdown code fence to close delays interception. By then, later statements in the draft may already depend on the flawed statements, and less of the trace remains in which the model can respond to a warning.
paragraphs.zh: C1. 在不完全的令牌流上触发扫描。 标准的静态分析工具（例如 Semgrep (Semgrep, Inc., 2026) 和 Bandit (PyCQA, 2026)）会解析完整且语法正确的代码，因此在任意的令牌边界处触发分析会产生 AST 解析器拒绝接受的片段。 在另一个极端情况下，等待 Markdown 代码围栏闭合会延迟拦截。 到那时，草稿中后续的语句可能已经依赖于有缺陷的语句，而模型能够响应警告的痕迹也所剩无几。

sents.en: Triggering Scans on Incomplete Token Streams.
sents.zh: 在不完全的令牌流上触发扫描。

sents.en: Standard static analyzers (such as Semgrep ( Semgrep, Inc., 2026 ) and Bandit ( PyCQA, 2026 ) ) parse complete, syntactically valid code, so triggering analysis at arbitrary token boundaries yields fragments that AST parsers reject.

sents.en: At the other extreme, waiting for a markdown code fence to close delays interception.
sents.zh: 在另一个极端情况下，等待 Markdown 代码围栏闭合会延迟拦截。

sents.en: By then, later statements in the draft may already depend on the flawed statements, and less of the trace remains in which the model can respond to a warning.

paragraphs.en: C2. Balancing Analysis Latency with Cross-Statement Dataflow Context. Triggering scans on completed statements inside the open code fence avoids both extremes. The analyzer must then decide what to rescan. Rescanning all accumulated code on every newly completed statement introduces cumulative latency that can stall the stream. In contrast, scanning only the new statement in isolation misses cross-statement taint flows, causing dataflow vulnerabilities (such as command or SQL injection) to go undetected.
paragraphs.zh: C2. 平衡分析延迟与跨语句数据流上下文。 在开放代码围栏内对已完成的语句触发扫描，可避免两种极端情况。 随后，分析器必须决定需要重新扫描哪些内容。 每次新语句完成时都重新扫描所有累积的代码，会产生累积延迟，可能导致数据流停滞。 相比之下，仅单独扫描新语句则会遗漏跨语句的污染流，导致数据流漏洞（如命令注入或 SQL 注入）未被检测。

sents.en: Balancing Analysis Latency with Cross-Statement Dataflow Context.
sents.zh: 平衡分析延迟与跨语句数据流上下文。

sents.en: Triggering scans on completed statements inside the open code fence avoids both extremes.
sents.zh: 在开放代码围栏内对已完成的语句触发扫描，可避免两种极端情况。

sents.en: The analyzer must then decide what to rescan.
sents.zh: 随后，分析器必须决定需要重新扫描哪些内容。

sents.zh: 每次新语句完成时都重新扫描所有累积的代码，会产生累积延迟，可能导致数据流停滞。

sents.en: In contrast, scanning only the new statement in isolation misses cross-statement taint flows, causing dataflow vulnerabilities (such as command or SQL injection) to go undetected.
sents.zh: 相比之下，仅单独扫描新语句则会遗漏跨语句的污染流，导致数据流漏洞（如命令注入或 SQL 注入）未被检测。

paragraphs.en: C3. Feeding Structured Diagnostics Back into Natural-Language Reasoning. Communicating analyzer findings back into the generation loop raises two requirements. First, static analyzers output structured findings (e.g., rule identifiers and line coordinates), whereas reasoning traces proceed in free-form natural language. Raw findings must therefore be converted into actionable guidance. Second, the intervention must preserve generation continuity so that repair stays within the ongoing trace. Aborting the stream to prompt repair in a new conversational turn discards the partially generated reasoning trace and forces full-response regeneration.
paragraphs.zh: C3. 将结构化诊断结果反馈到自然语言推理中。 将分析器发现的结果反馈到生成循环中，会提出两项要求。 首先，静态分析器输出结构化发现（例如规则标识符和行坐标），而推理轨迹则以自由形式的自然语言进行。 因此，必须将原始发现结果转换为可操作的指导。 其次，干预措施必须保持生成的连续性，以便修复能够保持在正在进行的推理轨迹中。 中断流以在新的对话回合中提示修复，会丢弃部分生成的推理轨迹，并强制重新生成完整响应。

sents.zh: 将结构化诊断结果反馈到自然语言推理中。

paragraphs.en: Section 3 presents SecReason , designed to address each of these challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节介绍了 SecReason，该设计旨在应对上述每一项挑战。

paragraphs.en: Pre-delivery interception requires reconciling static analysis with streaming generation.
paragraphs.zh: 交付前拦截需要协调静态分析与流式生成。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of SecReason , which operates as an in-stream monitor situated between the LLM inference engine and downstream clients. As the engine streams response tokens during reasoning, SecReason inspects the stream and processes it through two main stages, streaming detection and in-stream self-repair.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了 SecReason 的整体架构，它作为一个流式监控器，位于 LLM 推理引擎和下游客户端之间。 当推理引擎在推理过程中逐流输出响应词元时，SecReason 会检查该流，并通过两个主要阶段进行处理：流式检测和流内自我修复。

sents.zh: 图 2 展示了 SecReason 的整体架构，它作为一个流式监控器，位于 LLM 推理引擎和下游客户端之间。

sents.en: As the engine streams response tokens during reasoning, SecReason inspects the stream and processes it through two main stages, streaming detection and in-stream self-repair.
sents.zh: 当推理引擎在推理过程中逐流输出响应词元时，SecReason 会检查该流，并通过两个主要阶段进行处理：流式检测和流内自我修复。

paragraphs.en: During streaming detection, SecReason parses the code drafts that reasoning models write within code fences (e.g., \‘\‘\‘ py ) as tokens arrive and applies a dual-track scanning strategy. When a rule triggers, SecReason inserts an in-stream warning that prompts the model to repair the draft within the ongoing reasoning trace.
paragraphs.zh: 在流式检测过程中，SecReason 会随着令牌的到来解析推理模型在代码围栏（例如：‘‘‘ py）中编写的代码草稿，并采用双轨扫描策略。 当某个规则被触发时，SecReason 会插入一个流内警告，提示模型修复当前推理轨迹中的草稿。

paragraphs.en: SecReason performs rule-based static analysis over the streamed tokens. Tree - sitter re-parses the code draft as tokens arrive ( Tree-sitter Project, 2026 ) , and semgrep - core , which covers the five evaluated languages, matches security rules against it ( Semgrep, Inc., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: SecReason 对流式分词执行基于规则的静态分析。 Tree-sitter 在代码草案的分词逐步到达时进行重新解析（Tree-sitter Project，2026），而涵盖五种受评估语言的 semgrep-core 则据此匹配安全规则（Semgrep, Inc.，2026）。

sents.zh: SecReason 对流式分词执行基于规则的静态分析。

sents.en: Tree - sitter re-parses the code draft as tokens arrive ( Tree-sitter Project, 2026 ) , and semgrep - core , which covers the five evaluated languages, matches security rules against it ( Semgrep, Inc., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Tree-sitter 在代码草案的分词逐步到达时进行重新解析（Tree-sitter Project，2026），而涵盖五种受评估语言的 semgrep-core 则据此匹配安全规则（Semgrep, Inc.，2026）。

paragraphs.en: The finest unit SecReason scans is the completed statement. In a token stream a statement’s end is not marked, so SecReason recognizes completion by parsing. The code to parse is the token sequence inside a markdown fence, a line that starts with \‘\‘\‘ whose tag (e.g., py for Python) selects the grammar. Each parse round builds an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) over these tokens, and a statement is complete when it parses cleanly. Partial trailing syntax sits in a localized ERROR node, while every completed statement keeps a valid subtree.

paragraphs.en: Clean parsing does not mean the enclosing construct is finished. The body of a function definition is syntactically complete after a single line, but the model may append further statements to it. Such appends are not missed, since each appended statement completes at an unseen end position and is extracted on a later round. paragraphs.zh: 干净的解析并不意味着其包围结构已经结束。 函数定义的主体在单行代码之后从语法上来说是完整的，但模型可能会在其后追加更多语句。 这类追加内容不会被遗漏，因为每个追加的语句都会在一个未见的结束位置完成，并在后续轮次中被提取出来。 包围结构是否完成，仅对那些证据跨越多个语句的规则而言才重要。 下面的双轨设计恰好将这些规则推迟到定义闭合的边界处处理。

paragraphs.en: Context-dependent track ( ℛ window \mathcal{R}_{\text{window}} ). This track contains the remaining rules, whose matching evidence or scoping context spans statements. Examples include taint rules tracing untrusted inputs into SQL queries (CWE-89) or system commands (CWE-78) and structural constraints such as sensitive operations inside public API routes. SecReason evaluates ℛ window \mathcal{R}_{\text{window}} over 𝒲 \mathcal{W} at three boundaries, the closing of an enclosing function or class definition containing sink identifiers, the closing of a code fence, and the termination of generation. At the first boundary the definition’s variable scopes are complete. The final scan covers unclosed fences and the delivered code.

paragraphs.en: When a rule matches in either track, SecReason outputs a structured finding f = ⟨ r id , r diag , s r , r fix ⟩ f=\langle r_{\text{id}},r_{\text{diag}},s_{r},r_{\text{fix}}\rangle containing the rule identifier, a diagnostic summary naming the CWE category, the offending code snippet, and a remediation guideline.
paragraphs.zh: 当规则在任一轨道中匹配时，SecReason 会输出一个结构化发现 f = ⟨ r id , r diag , s r , r fix ⟩ f=\langle r_{\text{id}},r_{\text{diag}},s_{r},r_{\text{fix}}\rangle，其中包含规则标识符、指出 CWE 类别的诊断摘要、违规代码片段以及修复指南。

paragraphs.en: Upon receiving a finding f f , SecReason guides the model to revise the code without discarding its ongoing reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 在接收到发现 f f 后，SecReason 会引导模型修订代码，同时不丢弃其正在进行的推理过程。

paragraphs.en: When a rule triggers, SecReason interrupts token production and retains the ongoing reasoning trace as T stream T_{\text{stream}} . From finding f f , SecReason synthesizes an in-stream warning T warn T_{\text{warn}} and inserts it into the ongoing stream. The warning is addressed to the model in the second person. It pairs the rule’s diagnostic summary ( r diag r_{\text{diag}} ) and remediation guidance ( r fix r_{\text{fix}} ) with the offending code snippet ( s r s_{r} ), and closes with a constraint to eliminate the vulnerability while preserving functionality. When the same rule triggers a second time, the header escalates to state that the issue persists. Listing 5 shows the warning instantiated for a CWE-78 finding.
paragraphs.zh: 当一条规则被触发时，SecReason 会中断标记生成过程，并将正在进行的推理痕迹保留为 T 流 T_{\text{stream}}。 从缺陷 f f 的发现出发，SecReason 会合成一个流内警告 T warn T_{\text{warn}}，并将其插入到当前的流中。 该警告以第二人称的形式向模型发出。 它将规则的诊断摘要（ r diag r_{\text{diag}}）和修复指南（ r fix r_{\text{fix}}）与存在问题的代码片段（ s r s_{r}）关联起来，并以一项约束作为结尾，要求在消除漏洞的同时保留原有功能。 当同一条规则第二次被触发时，标题部分会升级提示问题仍然存在。 列表 5 展示了针对 CWE-78 缺陷实例化的警告内容。

paragraphs.en: After generation resumes, a rule can fire again, either because the rewritten code still contains the flaw or because a dataflow begins in the pre-warning draft and ends in the newly generated code. To prevent infinite repair loops, SecReason enforces a configurable interruption cap K r K_{r} per rule. Once interventions for rule r r reach K r K_{r} , SecReason suppresses further interruptions for that rule and allows generation to continue, while still monitoring for other rule violations.
paragraphs.zh: 生成恢复后，一条规则可能再次触发，原因可能是重写的代码中仍然存在缺陷，也可能是预警告草案中的数据流开始并在新生成的代码中结束。 为防止无限修复循环，SecReason 对每条规则强制执行一个可配置的打断上限 K r K_{r}。 一旦规则 r r 的干预次数达到 K r K_{r}，SecReason 就会抑制该规则的进一步打断，并允许生成继续执行，同时仍然监控其他规则的违反情况。

paragraphs.en: After inserting the warning, SecReason resumes decoding within the active stream, so the model can revise its draft in place. SecReason constructs a continuation request T cont = T prompt ∘ T stream ∘ T warn T_{\text{cont}}=T_{\text{prompt}}\circ T_{\text{stream}}\circ T_{\text{warn}} , where T prompt T_{\text{prompt}} is the task prompt, T stream T_{\text{stream}} is the generated token sequence prior to interception, and ∘ \circ denotes token concatenation. paragraphs.en: Benchmarks and Corpora. To evaluate detection accuracy on static code (Section 4.2 ), we construct the Multi-Language Static Corpus . It comprises 2,878 samples balanced equally between vulnerable code from Purple Llama ( Bhatt et al., 2023 ) and benign solutions from Rosetta Code ( Nanz and Furia, 2015 ) across four languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, and C). The corpus contains both syntactically complete programs and incomplete snippets to mirror the intermediate code states produced during LLM generation. We omit C++ because the official Semgrep registry provides no default security rules for it. To evaluate in-stream detection, self-repair, and robustness, we use 173 tasks from two executable security benchmarks, CWEval ( Peng et al., 2025 ) (97 tasks) and SecCodeBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) (76 tasks), covering five languages with sandboxed functional tests and dynamic exploit payloads.

paragraphs.en: Compared Methods. We benchmark SecReason against four alternative methods under identical prompts. First, Hardened Prompt is a static baseline whose system prompt tells the model that its code will run in production under strict security requirements, and directs it to re-read its draft and fix any weaknesses before finishing. Second, Post-Hoc Repair scans each completed response. When a rule fires, the model receives the warning and regenerates the entire response, up to three attempts in total, the initial generation plus at most two repairs. Post-Hoc Repair applies the same warning template and ruleset as SecReason with a comparable attempt budget, so the two methods differ mainly in when the warning arrives, after delivery versus mid-stream. Third, INDICT ( Le et al., 2024 ) is a critique-repair method that also acts after generation. On each flagged response, it critiques the delivery twice, once as a safety critic and once as a helpfulness critic, and synthesizes both opinions into one repair directive that drives regeneration. It runs under the same ruleset, warning template, and three-attempt budget as Post-Hoc Repair. Fourth, RAG-Guided Prompt adapts Security Course ( Lin et al., 2025 ) by prepending a CWE knowledge block to the Hardened Prompt. The block is rendered from a knowledge base distilled from the same rule corpus SecReason ’s detector uses, with weakness descriptions, mitigations, and secure reference patterns. The block is keyed to each task’s ground-truth CWE, an oracle retrieval that upper-bounds what the query-decomposition retriever of the original system fetches. RAG-Guided Prompt completes in a single pass with no detection, so the comparison with SecReason varies only in where the same security guidance enters, the prompt before generation or the reasoning stream during generation.
paragraphs.zh: 对比方法。 我们在相同提示词下，将 SecReason 与四种替代方法进行了基准对比。 首先，Hardened Prompt 是一种静态基线方法，其系统提示词告知模型，其代码将在严格的安全要求下于生产环境中运行，并指示其在完成前重新阅读草稿并修复任何弱点。 其次，Post-Hoc Repair 会扫描每个已完成的响应。 当某条规则被触发时，模型会收到警告并重新生成整个响应，总共最多尝试三次，即初始生成加上最多两次修复。 Post-Hoc Repair 应用了与 SecReason 相同的警告模板和规则集，且尝试次数预算相当，因此这两种方法的主要区别在于警告出现的时间：在响应交付之后还是在生成过程中。 第三，INDICT（Le et al., 2024）是一种批判-修复方法，同样在生成后发挥作用。 对于每个被标记的响应，它会进行两次批判：一次作为安全批判者，另一次作为有效性批判者，然后将两种意见综合为一个修复指令以驱动重新生成。 它在与 Post-Hoc Repair 相同的规则集、警告模板和三次尝试预算下运行。 第四，RAG-Guided Prompt 通过在前端 Hardened Prompt 中添加一个 CWE 知识块，对 Security Course（Lin et al., 2025）进行了改编。 该知识块从知识库中渲染生成，而该知识库是从 SecReason 检测器使用的相同规则语料库中提取的，包含弱点描述、缓解措施和安全参考模式。 该知识块与每个任务的真实 CWE 相关联，这是一种“神谕式”检索，其结果上限为原始系统中查询分解检索器所能获取的信息。 RAG-Guided Prompt 在一次通过中完成生成，不涉及检测环节，因此与 SecReason 的对比仅在于相同的安全指导介入的位置不同：是在生成前的提示词中，还是在生成过程中的推理流中。

paragraphs.en: To answer RQ2, we examine rule coverage on delivered code offline to establish the ruleset under which streams are monitored. Across the six models, the 173 tasks produce 888 functionally valid generations, of which 324 contain vulnerabilities across 20 CWE categories. Benchmark execution verdicts provide the ground truth. The official Semgrep registry rules cover only 13 13 of the 20 20 categories at 59.8% precision, 36.7% recall, and a 45.5% F1 score, so most insecure generations go undetected. We therefore calibrate the ruleset with an LLM agent built on GLM - 5.3 . The synthesis corpus is the unassisted generations of the two locally deployed models over the full task pool. The other four models’ generations are held out from synthesis. The corpus-calibrated rules cover all 20 20 categories at 98.2% precision, 99.7% recall, and a 98.9% F1 score over all 888 generations (Table 3 ).

paragraphs.en: Because repair can only be measured on tasks where the models actually introduce vulnerabilities, we screen all 173 173 tasks with five repetitions of unassisted generation ( RAW ) per model and retain tasks with at least one Insecure & Func. run. paragraphs.en: Hardened Prompt improves over the RAW baseline, but up to 29.7 % 29.7\% of its runs remain Insecure & Func. , and its Secure & Func. rate never exceeds 66.2 % 66.2\% . A manual audit of all 187 187 insecure Hardened Prompt runs finds that in 72 % 72\% of them the model identifies the potential vulnerability in the trace but still delivers insecure code. It either declines the mitigation outright, on the grounds that the prompt did not request it or that an external layer is responsible, or targets the correct vulnerability class but incompletely, such as an SSRF check that filters private IP addresses while leaving automatic redirects enabled. paragraphs.en: Static security rules may raise false positives in deployment. To answer RQ4, we isolate false-positive handling from genuine vulnerability remediation by sampling fifteen vulnerability-free tasks and constructing weakened rules in two false-positive settings. (1) Essential FP matches a construct that no correct solution omits (e.g., any hashlib call in a hashing task). (2) Incidental FP matches a construct that has a semantically equivalent alternative (e.g., replacing malloc ( n ) with calloc ( n , 1) ). For each task, we execute five independent runs of Post-Hoc Repair, INDICT, and SecReason under each setting and model, the only methods that act on rule warnings. Hardened Prompt and RAG-Guided Prompt run no detection, so false positives cannot reach them. The fifteen tasks are sampled from CWEval and SecCodeBench , three per language (C, C++, Java, JavaScript, and Python), disjoint from the self-repair task pool. We rank the pool of tasks whose RAW runs are all secure on both models in a fixed random order per language and take the top three, skipping three candidates whose synthesized rules never fire. Table 8 lists the fifteen sampled tasks and their weakened rules.
paragraphs.zh: 静态安全规则在部署时可能会引发误报。 为回答研究问题4，我们通过抽取十五个无漏洞任务并在两种误报场景下构建弱化规则，将误报处理与真正的漏洞修复隔离开来。 (1) 关键性误报匹配的是任何正确解决方案都不会遗漏的结构（例如，哈希任务中的任何 hashlib 调用）。 (2) 偶然性误报匹配的是具有语义等价替代方案的结构（例如，将 malloc(n) 替换为 calloc(n, 1)）。 对于每个任务，我们在每种设置和模型下执行 Post-Hoc Repair、INDICT 和 SecReason 的五个独立运行，这些是唯一会对规则警告采取行动的方法。 强化提示和 RAG 引导提示不会执行检测，因此误报无法到达它们。 这十五个任务从 CWEval 和 SecCodeBench 中抽取，每种语言（C、C++、Java、JavaScript 和 Python）各三个，且与自我修复任务池互斥。 我们按语言以固定随机顺序排列那些在两种模型下 RAW 运行均安全的任务池，并选取排名前三的任务，同时跳过其合成规则从未触发的三个候选任务。 表8列出了这十五个被抽取的任务及其弱化规则。

paragraphs.en: Model responses to false positives. When SecReason intercepts generation mid-stream, the warning enters the active reasoning context alongside the preceding reasoning trace and drafted code prefix. The model can thus compare the finding with its ongoing plan. Post-warning traces fall into three patterns across the 93 93 triggered runs of the five audited tasks, the top-ranked candidate of each language. In 45 % 45\% of them the model explicitly refutes the warning as spurious. In 38 % 38\% it accepts the warning but verifies the suggested fix against the ongoing plan before acting. In 17 % 17\% it resumes its reasoning without addressing it. For Post-Hoc Repair, the warning arrives as a new instruction (“A security check found an issue in your code … Fix it”). In 75 % 75\% of the 92 92 fired rounds the model accepts the warning ( 53 % 53\% from the outset, 22 % 22\% before questioning it mid-reasoning) and treats it as an instruction to satisfy, and attempts to eliminate benign constructs. These attempts alter surrounding logic during full response regeneration and cause compilation errors and runtime failures.
paragraphs.zh: 模型对误报的反应。 当 SecReason 在生成过程中进行拦截时，该警告会与先前的推理轨迹和已起草的代码前缀一同进入主动推理上下文。 因此，模型可以将这一发现与其正在进行的计划进行比较。 在五个受审计任务的 93 次触发运行中，每次语言排名最高的候选模型在警告后的推理轨迹呈现出三种模式。 在这些情况中，有 45% 的情况下，模型明确驳斥该警告为虚假警报。 在 38% 的情况下，模型接受该警告，但在采取行动前会验证建议的修复方案是否与当前计划一致。 在 17% 的情况下，模型继续其推理过程而未处理该警告。 对于事后修复，该警告以一条新指令的形式出现：“安全检测发现您的代码中存在一个问题……请修复它。” 在 92 次触发的运行中，有 75% 的情况下，模型接受了该警告（其中 53% 从一开始就接受，22% 在推理过程中才接受），并将其视为需要满足的指令，同时试图消除无害的代码结构。 这些尝试在完全重新生成响应时改变了周围的逻辑，并导致了编译错误和运行时故障。

paragraphs.en: Rule calibration. The corpus-calibrated ruleset is synthesized and evaluated on the same task pool. Model-level overfitting is bounded, since the four remote models are held out from synthesis. Detection on their insecure generations remains at 99.5 % 99.5\% , against perfect detection for the two locally deployed models (Table 4 ). Task-level overfitting is not bounded, since the synthesis corpus and the evaluation streams draw on the same 173 tasks. A task-level split confirms that the rules recall their calibration corpus far better than held-out tasks, so the ruleset is corpus-specific rather than a transferable vulnerability detector (Section 4.3.1 ). paragraphs.en: Vulnerability Detection for LLM-Generated Code. Prior defenses during generation primarily enforce syntactic validity via token masking on formal grammars ( Willard and Louf, 2023 ; Ugare et al., 2025 ) or condition lines on execution feedback ( Lavon et al., 2025 ) , monitor reasoning traces for alignment risks ( Baker et al., 2025 ) , or suppress jailbreak continuations at decoding time ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . However, these mechanisms rely on local token-level constraints, execution-state consistency, or pure text matching, leaving semantic security vulnerabilities (e.g., taint-style injections) that span multiple statements unexamined. Conversely, post-generation checkers such as GPTScan ( Sun et al., 2024 ) and IRIS ( Li et al., 2025 ) analyze code logic with static rules or LLMs. While capable of semantic analysis, they operate only after code generation completes, decoupling detection from the model’s internal generation process.
paragraphs.zh: 针对大型语言模型生成代码的漏洞检测。 生成阶段的早期防御主要通过形式化语法的词元掩码来确保句法有效性（Willard和Louf，2023；Ugare等，2025），或根据执行反馈设置条件行（Lavon等，2025），监控推理轨迹以识别对齐风险（Baker等，2025），或在解码时抑制越狱式续写（Xu等，2024）。 然而，这些机制依赖于局部的词元级约束、执行状态的一致性或纯粹的文本匹配，导致跨越多个语句的语义安全漏洞（例如，污染式注入）未被检测。 相比之下，生成后的检查工具如GPTScan（Sun等，2024）和IRIS（Li等，2025）则使用静态规则或大型语言模型来分析代码逻辑。 尽管这些工具能够进行语义分析，但它们仅在代码生成完成后才开始运行，使得检测过程与模型内部的生成流程脱节。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-Driven Code Repair and Prompt Defenses. Feedback-driven repair refines LLM-generated code via external execution signals or compiler errors ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . For security remediation, existing approaches fine-tune specialized repair models on historical vulnerability commits ( Fu et al., 2022 ) , edit lines zero-shot ( Xia and Zhang, 2022 ) , or feed static analysis alarms back into the LLM for patching ( Alrashedy et al., 2025 ) . Similarly, dual-critique frameworks like INDICT ( Le et al., 2024 ) synthesize safety and helpfulness critiques into multi-turn revisions. However, such multi-turn loops incur high token overhead from regenerating entire responses, and false static alarms can rewrite correct code (Section 4.5 quantifies both costs). Beyond these repair loops, prompt defenses such as Security Course ( Lin et al., 2025 ) prepend retrieved vulnerability fixes to the prompt before generation begins, but cannot verify the delivered code. We adapt these representative paradigms as baselines in Section 4.4 .

paragraphs.en: This paper presents SecReason , an in-stream defense system that monitors reasoning streams to detect vulnerable code drafts and guides the model to repair them before delivery. Evaluations on CWEval and SecCodeBench show that, on the tasks where unassisted generation introduces vulnerabilities, SecReason raises the share of secure and functionally correct code from below 15% to 72.8%–98.1% under a corpus-calibrated ruleset. Repairing within the same reasoning trace costs fewer tokens and leaves smaller functional regressions from rule false positives than post-hoc repair.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 SecReason，一个流式防御系统，它通过监控推理流来检测存在漏洞的代码草案，并在代码交付前引导模型进行修复。 在 CWEval 和 SecCodeBench 上的评估表明，对于无辅助生成会引入漏洞的任务，SecReason 在基于语料库校准的规则集下，将安全且功能正确的代码比例从低于 15% 提升到了 72.8%–98.1%。 在同一推理轨迹内进行修复所需的 token 更少，并且由于规则误报而导致的函数回归也小于事后修复。
